entries.value: "Native compliance-standards source of truth for base-studio-code (#1005) — the single, user-updatable store of current regulation / accessibility / user-protection standards (WCAG 2.2, GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2, …). Shipped as the bundled `bsc-compliance-mcp` stdio MCP server so the planner can bake the right requirements into every plan, and standards can be refreshed without an app release."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# The core lib (no Tauri, no async runtime) so the bundled MCP binary stays lean and the
# store/parse logic is unit-testable against in-memory fixtures with no live network.
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# Shared leaf utilities (#1646): the one epoch clock (`now_secs`).
# (object-or-array), so the `bsc-compliance` CLI matches the `bsc-plan`/`bsc-skill` house style.
# `conn` adds the `:memory:`-aware open + default-path + JSON-blob row plumbing the store shares (#1863).
# Shared stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 core (#1622): the handshake, builders, dispatch, and run-loop. This crate
# supplies its own `tool_schemas` + `call_tool` + arg parsers via the `ToolServer` trait.
# Embed the baseline standards corpus (`corpus/*.json`) at compile time (#1614), so the seed is
# versioned, editable data rather than Rust literals — the same pattern as `data/stages/*.json`.
# Local on-disk store of the standards corpus (keyed by canonical id), so the rules the planner
# bakes in are user-owned + updatable without an app release. `bundled` matches plandb/research.
